## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
library(MASS)
library(here)
```

## #2 Create Table

```{r}
potencia <- data.frame(Intervention = character(20),
                       Lifespan_Effect = numeric(20),
                       Chronological_Effect = numeric (20),
                       Mortality_Effect = numeric (20))
```

## #3 Create Intervention Column

```{r}
for (row in 1:20) {
  potencia$Intervention[row] = paste0("Drug_", row)
}
```

## #4 Create Simulated Effect Data

```{r}
simulated_data <- function(target_corr=0, noise_mean = 0, noise_sd = 0.3) {

  cor_matrix <- matrix(
    c(
      1,   target_corr, target_corr,
      target_corr, 1,   0.7,
      target_corr, 0.7, 1
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  effects <- MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = 20,
    mu = c(0, 0, 0),
    Sigma = cor_matrix
  )
  
  #Add Noise to Data
  noise1 = rnorm(20, mean = noise_mean, sd = noise_sd)
  noise2 = rnorm(20, mean = noise_mean, sd = noise_sd)
  noise3 = rnorm(20, mean = noise_mean, sd = noise_sd)
  
  effects[,1] = effects[,1] + noise1
  effects[,2] = effects[,2] + noise2
  effects[,3] = effects[,3] + noise3
  
  return(effects)
}
```

## #5 Calculate Correlations

```{r}
corr <- function(df, met="pearson") {
  
  corr_c = cor(df$Lifespan_Effect, df$Chronological_Effect, method = met)
  corr_m = cor(df$Lifespan_Effect, df$Mortality_Effect, method = met)
  
  delta_corr = corr_m - corr_c
  
  return (delta_corr)
}
```

## #6 Simulate 1000 Times

### #6.1 Mean by target_corr

```{r}
target_corr_values <- c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9)

results <- data.frame(
  target_corr = target_corr_values,
  Mean_DeltaR = numeric(4),
  Percentile_Range = numeric(4)
)

for (i in seq_along(target_corr_values)) {
  delta_corr_values <- replicate(1000, {
    effects <- simulated_data(target_corr_values[i])
    df <- potencia
    df[, 2:4] <- effects
    corr(df)
  })
  
  results$Mean_DeltaR[i] <- mean(delta_corr_values)
  results$Percentile_Range[i] <-
    quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.975) -
    quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.025)
}

results
```

## #7 Export File

```{r}
write.csv(results, here("results","potencia_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
